purpose: Pins every input that could cause the in-domain corpus / detector to diverge across the 5080 (reference), 4060, and Apple M4, plus the 5080-produced reference values the other machines verify against. The 5080 fills the null fields ONCE (Step A of OPERATOR_GUIDE.md); the filled manifest then ships unchanged to both external machines.

experiments.#1 / #3: in-domain hard-gate: 3 densities x 3 seeds -> cluster_coh gap, SNR, ASR, DocFPR
experiments.#2 / #4: in-domain hard-gate: per-query latency + device backend

poison.source: REGENERATED in-memory by xplat_poison_gen.generate_corpus(10000) -- fully DETERMINISTIC (50 base docs x variant cross-product; no randomness, no embedding). NOT shipped as a file; the runner hash-checks the regenerated texts against the canonical hash below.

detector.type: cluster_coh HARD GATE (flag iff cluster_coh > tau)
detector.calibration: NON-ORACLE: tau = (100 - 0.69) percentile of CLEAN cluster_coh; no poison knowledge, no oracle density
detector.note: The v7.1.3 10-signal composite is NEVER constructed or scored. The frozen cluster_coh K-NN math is byte-identical to seva_benchmark_4060.py (imported into seva_xplat_common.py).

pinned_source_revisions._note: Resolved + pinned 2026-06-02. All 3 machines build from EXACTLY these dataset commits, so the source data cannot drift between the (earlier) 4060/M4 runs and the (later) 5080 run. The canonical corpus SHA-256 then proves byte-identity.

_pinned_encoder_note: 5080 records the bge-large-en-v1.5 commit SHA here (e.g. from `huggingface_hub.HfApi().model_info('BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5').sha`). Identical encoder weights -> embeddings differ ONLY by hardware float noise (which the cluster_coh gap is robust to). Different weights would invalidate the comparison.

reference._note: PRE-PINNED 2026-06-02 from the canonical corpus the paper used. VERIFIED: build_corpus_xplat.py at the pinned commits reproduces that corpus byte-identically in SET AND ORDER (ordered hash below). So the 4060/M4 gate against this canonical corpus IMMEDIATELY (auto-STOP on any divergence); they do NOT need to wait for the 5080. The 5080's later run re-verifies. The numeric fields (gap/asr/...) are filled when the 5080 reference run completes.
reference.corpus_canonical_sha256_kind: ORDER-SENSITIVE: per-doc SHA-256(text) in corpus order (doc_0..doc_99999) + count; captures the exact document set AND their order. Order matters because poison replaces corpus[0:P].
reference.corpus_fingerprint_note: 100000 lines, one SHA-256(text) hex per line in canonical order; lets the runner verify the rebuilt corpus DOC-BY-DOC and report the first divergent index.

package_versions_5080._fill: 5080 records its env here (from result_5080.json -> env) so the externals can match major versions.

PASS_if: cluster_coh gap density-invariant: range across 1/5/10% <= 0.05 AND every gap > 0.15
preregistration.on_DIVERGE: A result that fails a PASS check is a PRIVATE NEGATIVE: reportable to the operator, NOT auto-published. Treat a hash mismatch as 'wrong corpus -> discard'; treat a gap-collapse or ASR>0 on a hash-MATCHED corpus as a genuine new finding to investigate before any claim relies on it.
